description: Two signed Codex lanes, Unicode mesh round-trip loop guard, direct channel reply, attachment Blob upload and final audit ACK against a live Hub harness.
assertions: both Ed25519 lane keys require and receive explicit admin approval
Unicode mesh message is delivered and exactly one runtime reply is observed
replaying the same client_message_id returns the original message id and duplicate=true
a mesh reply is OBSERVED and never becomes a new automatic turn
channel inbound is ACKed only after local message and attachment durability
admin audit query returns the SHA-256-addressed attachment
